title: AllPDFMagic
description: PDF tools + invoice extraction, bank statement parsing, GST reconciliation & GSTIN validation.
summary: PDF tools + invoice extraction, bank statement parsing, GST reconciliation & GSTIN validation.
offersHint: PDF tools + invoice extraction, bank statement parsing, GST reconciliation & GSTIN validation. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.allpdfmagic.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: validate_gstin
toolsPreview.description: Validate an Indian GSTIN: format and check-digit (base-36 checksum). Catches typos and fabricated numbers instantly. Runs locally — no API key required. Note: does NOT confirm active registration on the GST portal.

toolsPreview.name: compress_pdf
toolsPreview.description: Compress a PDF file to reduce its size. Returns a download URL for the compressed file. Free tier: 500 calls/month.

toolsPreview.name: pdf_to_excel
toolsPreview.description: Convert a PDF (tables, statements, reports) to an Excel file. Returns a download URL. Requires Premium tier or above.

toolsPreview.name: extract_invoice_data
toolsPreview.description: Extract structured data from an invoice PDF: vendor, invoice number, date, line items, taxes (GST-aware), totals — as JSON. Requires Team tier or above.

toolsPreview.name: parse_bank_statement
toolsPreview.description: Parse a bank statement PDF (any Indian bank + international formats) into categorized transactions with dates, amounts, balances, payment modes (UPI/NEFT/ATM/...), and an income/expense summary. Requires Developer tier or above.

toolsPreview.name: reconcile_documents
toolsPreview.description: Reconcile two or more documents (e.g. purchase register vs GSTR-2B, bank statement vs ledger). Matches line items by GSTIN + invoice number + amount; reports matches, mismatches with exact fields, and unmatched items. Requires Developer tier or above.

toolsPreview.name: detect_document_fraud
toolsPreview.description: Screen a batch of 2+ invoices/documents for fraud signals: fabricated GSTINs (check-digit), duplicate invoice numbers across documents, duplicate/near-duplicate files, and amount anomalies. Requires Developer tier or above.
